title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_honey_so_sweet_vol_5_by_amu_meguro_6vbdo (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_honey_so_sweet_vol_5_by_amu_meguro_6vbdo' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
